reason: We have to replace E-Golf4U once and get it right for 950 members, and I can't put our whole administration, invoicing and tee sheet on a two-person company whose first pilot club isn't even live yet. The own-branded app is exactly what our members ask for at the desk, but the board will choose Nexxchange or IntoGolf because other clubs already run on them.
objection: Two founders and zero live clubs: if one of them quits or the migration goes wrong mid-season, I'm the one explaining to 950 members why they can't book or why invoices are wrong. And I still have to explain to the board why members need our app next to GOLF.NL.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing Golfclub Zwolle live for a full season on tee times and invoicing, with a reference call from their manager, plus an escrow or exit guarantee that our data and the members' bookings keep working if Greenside stops.
